template:
Create a hyper-realistic, highly professional standard ID photo (证件照) based on the subject's facial features.

=== CRITICAL STYLE REQUIREMENTS (MUST FOLLOW EXACTLY) ===

【OVERALL VISUAL CONCEPT】
- Ultra-realistic professional studio portrait photography.
- Standard ID photo format (Passport / Resume style).
- The subject must look directly into the camera with a natural, subtle, polite expression (no exaggerated smiling).
- Absolute symmetry: The face and shoulders must be perfectly centered and balanced.

【COLOR SYSTEM】
- Background: Perfect, solid, completely smooth {{background_color_display}} background.
- Lighting color: Neutral white studio light, clean and crisp.

【LAYOUT & STRUCTURE】
- Aspect ratio: 3:4.
- Framing: Chest-up shot (bust portrait).
- Top area: Slight negative space above the head.
- Middle area: Head centered, shoulders parallel and symmetrical at the bottom.
- Strict requirement: No tilted heads, no leaning, absolutely straight posture.

【PHOTOGRAPHIC ELEMENTS】
- Camera: Shot on 85mm portrait lens, f/5.6 for full depth of field on the face, 8K resolution.
- Lighting: Professional studio flat lighting / butterfly lighting. No harsh shadows on the face, perfect soft illumination, bright catchlights in the eyes.
- Texture: Realistic skin texture, pores visible but clear, no oily shine, highly detailed.

【MODULE REQUIREMENTS】
- Face: Retain original facial features but enhance symmetry and clarity. {{subject_features}}.
- Hair: Extremely neat, tidy hair, no messy stray hairs (flyaways), clean silhouette against the background. {{hair_style}}.
- Outfit: Strictly wearing {{clothing_style_display}}. The clothes must fit perfectly, wrinkle-free, and look highly professional.

【WHAT TO AVOID】
- No messy backgrounds (must be 100% solid color).
- No casual clothes (no t-shirts, hoodies, or straps).
- No tilted posture, no turning sideways.
- No heavy makeup or artificial AI-plastic looks (must look like a real photograph of a real person).
- No text or watermarks.

【CONTENT FOR THIS IMAGE】
Subject: {{subject_features}}
Outfit: {{clothing_style_display}}
Background: Solid {{background_color_display}} background.
Expression: Confident, calm, directly facing the camera, perfect ID photo posture.
Usage: {{usage_scenario}}
